setupStep: Vapi Live Telephony & Public Webhook Mapping
instructions: 1. Launch start-server.bat or run 'npm start' inside D:\Mini_Project\server.
2. If testing over a real phone call with Vapi, run D:\Mini_Project\scripts\setup_ngrok.bat on port 3000.
3. Copy the generated ngrok HTTPS forwarding URL e.g. https://a1b2-c3d4.ngrok-free.app
4. In Vapi Assistant Settings -> Server URL, paste: https://a1b2-c3d4.ngrok-free.app/api/webhook/vapi-end-call
5. Dial your Vapi assigned Twilio Phone Number to place a live voice call.
